final: SELECT SUM(state_total) AS combined_transaction_total, AVG(state_share) AS average_share, AVG(state_share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM (SELECT state_total, state_total / grand_total AS state_share, AVG(state_total / grand_total) OVER () AS average_share FROM (SELECT state_total, SUM(state_total) OVER () AS grand_total FROM (SELECT c.state_county_province, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS state_total FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts ac ON ac.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = ac.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province)) WHERE state_total / grand_total > average_share)
